import Mathlib

open scoped BigOperators

namespace GenusAudit

theorem determinant_frobenius
    {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [CharP R p]
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι R) :
    (A.map (frobenius R p)).det = A.det ^ p := by
  exact ((frobenius R p).map_det A).symm

theorem genus_recurrence_numerator
    (p q v next f image : ℚ)
    (hgenus : v = q * next + (p - 1) * f)
    (himage : image = v + f) :
    p * v = q * next + (p - 1) * image := by
  linear_combination hgenus - (p - 1) * himage

def discounted (t : ℚ) : List ℚ → ℚ
  | [] => 0
  | x :: xs => (1 - t) * x + t * discounted t xs

theorem prefix_weights (t : ℚ) (u : ℕ) :
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range u, (1 - t) * t ^ j) = 1 - t ^ u := by
  induction u with
  | zero => simp
  | succ u ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih, pow_succ]
      ring

theorem length_le_sum
    (m : List ℕ) (hm : ∀ x ∈ m, 1 ≤ x) :
    m.length ≤ m.sum := by
  induction m with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
      have hx : 1 ≤ x := hm x (by simp)
      have hxs : ∀ y ∈ xs, 1 ≤ y := by
        intro y hy
        exact hm y (by simp [hy])
      have htail := ih hxs
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.sum_cons]
      omega

theorem profile_error_bound
    (t h : ℚ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (m : List ℕ)
    (hm : ∀ x ∈ m, 1 ≤ x) :
    discounted t (m.map (fun x => h + (x : ℚ))) ≤
      (h + 1) * (1 - t ^ m.length) +
        (1 - t) * ((m.sum : ℚ) - (m.length : ℚ)) := by
  induction m with
  | nil => simp [discounted]
  | cons x xs ih =>
      have hxs : ∀ y ∈ xs, 1 ≤ y := by
        intro y hy
        exact hm y (by simp [hy])
      have htail := ih hxs
      have hlength : (xs.length : ℚ) ≤ (xs.sum : ℚ) := by
        exact_mod_cast length_le_sum xs hxs
      have hdelta :
          0 ≤ (1 - t) ^ 2 * ((xs.sum : ℚ) - (xs.length : ℚ)) :=
        mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sub_nonneg.mpr hlength)
      have hscaled := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail ht
      simp only [List.map_cons, discounted, List.length_cons, List.sum_cons,
        Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, pow_succ]
      calc
        (1 - t) * (h + (x : ℚ)) +
            t * discounted t (xs.map (fun y => h + (y : ℚ))) ≤
            (1 - t) * (h + (x : ℚ)) +
              t * ((h + 1) * (1 - t ^ xs.length) +
                (1 - t) * ((xs.sum : ℚ) - (xs.length : ℚ))) :=
          add_le_add_left hscaled _
        _ ≤ (h + 1) * (1 - t ^ xs.length * t) +
            (1 - t) * ((x : ℚ) + (xs.sum : ℚ) -
              ((xs.length : ℚ) + 1)) := by
          nlinarith [hdelta]

theorem degree_lattice_rounding
    (N A : ℤ) (hN : 0 < N) (hdiv : N ∣ A) (hA : -N < A) :
    0 ≤ A := by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hdiv
  have hmul : N * (-1) < N * k := by simpa using hA
  have hk : -1 < k := (mul_lt_mul_left hN).mp hmul
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ k := by omega
  exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hN) hk0

theorem exact_degree_bound
    (N nu branch : ℤ) (loss : ℚ)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hdiv : N ∣ nu - branch)
    (happrox : -loss ≤ ((nu - branch : ℤ) : ℚ))
    (hthreshold : loss < (N : ℚ)) :
    branch ≤ nu := by
  have hAq : (-(N : ℚ)) < ((nu - branch : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    linarith
  have hA : -N < nu - branch := by exact_mod_cast hAq
  exact sub_nonneg.mp (degree_lattice_rounding N (nu - branch) hN hdiv hA)

end GenusAudit

  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := hdiv
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ k := by
    by_contra hk
    have hkneg : k ≤ -1 := by omega
    have hprod := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkneg (le_of_lt hN)
    linarith
  exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hN) hk0

theorem exact_degree_bound
    (N nu branch : ℤ) (loss : ℚ)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hdiv : N ∣ nu - branch)
    (happrox : -loss ≤ ((nu - branch : ℤ) : ℚ))
    (hthreshold : loss < (N : ℚ)) :
    branch ≤ nu := by
  have hAq : (-(N : ℚ)) < ((nu - branch : ℤ) : ℚ) := by
    linarith
  have hA : -N < nu - branch := by exact_mod_cast hAq
  exact sub_nonneg.mp (degree_lattice_rounding N (nu - branch) hN hdiv hA)

end GenusAudit

claims.natural_statement: For a purely inseparable cover of a genus-one curve split as a constant elliptic curve over a finite separable extension of a finitely generated field over perfect characteristic-p constants, nu_F(Z)/d is at least the weighted sum of max(0,c_j-m_j), with c_j the rank of the ramified-label absolute conormal covectors. For an integer h>=0 bounding every subset's rank loss, the full marked-ramification bound follows under the exact degree-lattice threshold N>d sum_j (1-1/p)p^(-j)(h+m_j).

external_assumptions.statement: Finite type algebras over a field are Nagata; therefore normalization in a finite function-field extension is finite.

claims.natural_statement: For prime p, integer h>=0 and positive height-one stage ranks summing to a>=1, the weighted error is at most U_p(a,h)=max_(1<=b<=a) ((h+1)(1-p^(-b))+(1-1/p)(a-b)). The maximum is attained at b=min(a,min{b>=1:p^b>=h+1}); with U_p(0,h)=0, N>p^A U_p(A,h), A=floor(log_p m), suffices uniformly for d<=m.

The strict threshold N>dE in the generalized rank-profile theorem cannot uniformly be weakened to N>=dE: in characteristic two, the index-two translated torsor with constant orbit divisor O+P and its descended Frobenius endomorphism has h=1, d=2, N=dE=2, both local indices two, and nu=0. This is outside the manuscript's generic-label and strict-threshold hypotheses.
For a regular integral projective curve C over S finitely generated over perfect kappa, Omega_(C/kappa) is locally free of rank trdeg(S/kappa)+1 and deg_S det Omega_(C/kappa) = -2 chi_S(C).

external_assumptions.statement: For projective n-space over a field, the dualizing complex is O(-n-1)[n]; coherent Serre duality follows by the stated right-adjoint property.
For a finite type k-algebra A and prime q with residue field separable over k, A is smooth at q if and only if A_q is regular.
For a ringed space and derived complexes K bounded above and L bounded below, the local-to-global Ext spectral sequence H^p(Ext^q(K,L)) converges to Ext^(p+q)(K,L).
external_assumptions.locator: Section 20.43, Ext sheaves, local-to-global spectral sequence
